name: GRAMMER Offroad Intelligence Object Model
purpose: Defines the core intelligence objects behind the Offroad Intelligence Hub so pages remain views of shared intelligence objects rather than independent logic layers.
principle: Pages should contain minimal independent intelligence logic. Intelligence should be represented through shared objects, IDs, provenance and relationship rules.

coreObjects.description: Origin of evidence such as news article, company release, patent source, financial report, internal input or conference material.
Source-backed fact or observation with date, source, reliability, linked entities and provenance.
Generic entity layer for customers, competitors, technologies, applications, markets, geographies, products and themes.
Meaningful change or weak signal derived from evidence.
Clustered or repeated signals that indicate a wider market, customer, competitor or technology pattern.

coreObjects.mainQuestion: What does it mean for GRAMMER?
coreObjects.description: Analyst or AI-supported interpretation linking signals to implications, confidence, time horizon and affected functions.
Potential commercial, product, innovation or strategic upside.
Potential commercial, competitive, technology, supply or strategic exposure.
Technology capability, solution area or product-relevant development theme.
Recommended function-specific next step for Sales, R&D, Innovation, Product Management, Strategy, Procurement or Management.
Closed-loop result of an action, used to evaluate whether intelligence led to useful decisions or follow-up.
